description: Publishes a strategy to the public marketplace where users can discover it. Marketplace listing status is the public contract; bot deployments remain private. Tags can be set for categorization (holdingPeriod, riskLevel, plan tier). Free and paid monthly listings are supported. Paid listings force code protection. If already published, updates and returns the existing listing. For private 1:1 sharing, use strategy_share_link(action="create") instead.

accountId.description: Exact owned proof account; paper and real use separate listings.

allowHoldingsView.description: Whether public listing viewers can see holdings.

priceAmountCents.description: Monthly price in cents. Required for pricingModel=monthly.

protectCode.description: Hide strategy code. Paid monthly listings always force this true.

name: publish_to_marketplace
title: Publish a strategy to the public marketplace
